text: BAM share rose 0.2 percentage points over 26 hours and 0.28 percentage points over 7 days, to 32.8%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.5% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 58 top-node leadership changes in this window are consistent with whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
